subject: What we're building for your next 42 days
preview_text: A feature we've never talked about — and it changes everything for headphone users.
body_paragraphs: You've been with us 42 days. That's 1,008 hours of listening, give or take. And we've been watching — not creepily, but closely. The way you adjust EQ mid-song. The way you boost dialogue during podcasts. The way your headphones swap between music and gaming without missing a beat. We see you.

Here's the thing: we've been building something that no one else is doing. A feature that learns your listening habits — not just your headphones — and adjusts audio in real-time. It's like AutoEQ, but for your life. It knows when you're commuting, when you're gaming, when you're just trying to hear the dialogue over a dishwasher. And it tunes for that moment, not just the device.

We're calling it 'Adaptive Profiles' — and it's coming in the next update. No more switching profiles manually. No more wondering if your EQ is right for this track. It just works. And it works because you've already shown us what you need.

Open Loudify today and check your Sound DNA history. You'll see the patterns we're building on. Then, when the update drops, you'll be first in line. P.S. Adaptive Profiles will be Premium-only — but if you're already on a free trial, it'll unlock automatically.
